orb_overlay.filter_rule: Skip the top chop quartile of daily NQ chop scores.

notes.intraday: Desktop NQ live-safe feature store, restricted to RTH, refreshed from the daily desktop dataset update job.
notes.vwap_distance_bps: Signed distance from session VWAP in basis points during regular trading hours.
notes.trend_strength_adx: ADX-14 trend strength across the session.
notes.trend_score: ML-derived trend regime score scaled to 0-100.
notes.chop_score: ML-derived chop regime score scaled to 0-100.
notes.htf_axes: X is directional efficiency, Y is balance and rotation score, Z is chop score. Higher chop score means more auction balance and less directional persistence.
notes.htf_trend_axes: Trend surfaces keep directional efficiency on X, move trend alignment to Y, and map trend score on Z.
notes.orb_overlay: ORB overlays use the NQ desktop regime rows matched to the current ORB trade stream, preferring forwarded JSON when available.
